title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Crime for the Act of Raping the Victim in the Course of Trafficking in or Kidnapping Women (Young Girls)

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How to Convict the Act of Raping the Victim in the Course of Abducting and Trafficking in or Kidnapping Women (Girls)
Fa Fu [1994] No. 6
Higher People's Court of Sichuan Province, Higher People's Court of Henan Province:
The request for instructions on how to convict the act of a defendant raping the abducted or kidnapped women (girls) in the course of abducting and trafficking in or kidnapping women (girls) has been received. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
Where a defendant rapes an abducted woman (girl) in the course of abducting and trafficking in women (girls), he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of item (3) of the first paragraph of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Abduct and Traffic in or Kidnap Women or Children. Where a defendant rapes a kidnapped woman (girl) in the course of kidnapping women (girls), he shall be given a severe punishment respectively for the crime of kidnapping women, the crime of kidnapping children, or the crime of kidnapping for extortion.
April 8, 1994
